structured.approach: I loaded the requirement-steps procedure for REQ-01, then read the five contracted inputs (roadmap, regulatory sources, connector inventory, model dependency map, decision log), the ticket from record:intake and its GitHub source file requirements/ZD-48600.md. I also read the earlier run's REQ-01 evaluation. Two gaps it flagged are handled this time: the external-patterns check is now marked not applicable, and the missing notification is stated openly. Neither the Pre Backlog sheet nor the DevOps board was in context, so I searched the repository's requirement files for duplicates instead. That found three related open items (ZD-48211, ZD-48501, ZD-48455) but no duplicate. I split the ticket word for word into change requests CR-0 to CR-7 and linked the entry to roadmap item R-AP-12. I then checked it against decisions D-2026-031, D-2026-044 and D-2026-050 and lessons L-007 and L-011: none conflict. The connector, regulatory and model-dependency checks were each answered directly by an input. Gaps are recorded as labelled assumptions and non-blocking open questions; none is blocking. Shell use is denied in this step, so I used only Read, Glob and Grep.

claims.text: The intake is Zendesk ticket ZD-48600 (sample, synthetic) from the Customer Feedback channel, received 2026-10-24, with source link hobasa-agentic-sdlc/requirements/ZD-48600.md.
The ticket asks for changes in four repositories (ap_pipeline, ap_forecast, ap_aging, ap_portal) and an end-to-end proof: feed -> delays -> risk -> overdue list -> portal table.

The entry is linked to roadmap item R-AP-12 (give AP managers earlier visibility of overdue payables, Q4 2026, AP module, owner PM). It is not linked to R-AP-14 (aging export), because the ticket asks for no export.
No regulatory source applies to this change, so there is no section or page to cite and no rule is affected.
No source-system connector is affected by the ap_aging library.
ap_forecast uses provider acme-llm, model acme-text-2, for the payment-delay explanation, so the build_explanation_request prompt change depends on that model. vendor_risk uses no LLM.

No conflict with prior decisions: overdue_with_risk covers unpaid invoices only (D-2026-050), amounts stay Decimal (D-2026-044), and days past due follow calendar days (D-2026-031), which is stated as assumption A-1.
Boundary tests are needed at exactly 30 days past due and at predicted delays of exactly 30 and 10 days.
Open requirements ZD-48211 and ZD-48501 use the same rule: unpaid invoices more than 30 days past due count as overdue. ZD-48455 uses a similarly named 'overdue risk' row class in ap_portal.
According to the source file, the change is tier T2 with no finance posting, authentication, tenancy or payment execution, and the risk label is advisory only.

open_questions: OQ-1: The Pre Backlog sheet and the DevOps board were not in context, so the duplicate check covered only the requirement files. PM: please confirm there is no existing entry.
OQ-2: Is delay_days in calendar days, and should early payments (zero or negative delay) be included? D-2026-031 covers aging buckets only.
OQ-3: Should the new paid_date feed column be recorded as a feed or connector change? The inventory only says that ap_aging affects no connector.
OQ-4: How should a row be handled when paid and paid_date disagree?
OQ-5: What should vendor_risk return for a vendor with an empty history?
OQ-6: Should renderOverdueRisk HTML-escape vendor names and ids?
OQ-7: Should this entry be grouped with, or sequenced after, the related open items ZD-48211 and ZD-48501?
structured.summary: I wrote both REQ-01 outputs for PM review. feat.intake.md holds the verbatim ticket, its source link, and change requests CR-0 to CR-7 split across ap_pipeline, ap_forecast, ap_aging, ap_portal and the end-to-end flow. feat.prebacklog.md is a draft entry linked to roadmap item R-AP-12. It found no conflicts with the decision log, no regulatory impact and no connector impact; it records the acme-llm/acme-text-2 dependency for the explanation prompt and the boundary tests L-007 requires. The full duplicate check could not be done: the Pre Backlog sheet and DevOps board were not in context. A search of the repository's requirement files found three related open items (ZD-48211, ZD-48501, ZD-48455) but no duplicate. There are four assumptions and seven non-blocking open questions; none blocks the step. This step sent no notification; the entry is the content for the PM gate.
